Data.purpose: Contrôle compact générique pour inverser le sens de tri sans multiplier les libellés métier.
Data.comparator_policy: The dataset supplies the comparator. Strings use locale collation, semantic versions use semantic-version ordering, dates use chronological ordering, numbers use numeric ordering.

accessibility.rule: Icon-only buttons must expose the current direction and the action that will occur on activation.

rules: A/Z and Z/A represent generic ascending/descending direction; they do not force lexical comparison.
The active dataset decides the comparison key and comparator.
A single toggle may switch between az and za when no separate sort-key chooser is needed.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Primitive commune de tri croissant/décroissant avec SVG A→Z / Z→A.
